headline: Proposed amendments to the Rent Control Ordinance to strengthen enforcement, with a vote on a recommendation to City Council.
summary: The meeting covers proposed changes to the Rent Control Ordinance to strengthen enforcement, with public comment taken first. It also includes a quarterly Rent Control report, a panel discussion on Inclusionary Zoning, and a verbal update on the Bloomberg Cities Idea Exchange.
items: Quarter 3 (July 1 to September 30, 2026) Rent Control Report, presented by Jessica Quattropani, Permitting and Inspections Department Director; no committee action required
Public comment, then review and vote on a recommendation to City Council on proposed amendments to the Rent Control Ordinance to strengthen enforcement; Councilor Pious Ali, Chair
Panel discussion on Inclusionary Zoning with Bradley Davis and Ethan Strimling; no public comment will be taken
Verbal update on the Bloomberg Cities Idea Exchange by Mayor Mark Dion; no public comment will be taken

Housing & Economic 
Development Committee Meeting  
Tuesday, October 20, 2026 at 5:30 PM 
 
 
  
MEMBERS 
Councilor Pious Ali, Chair 
Councilor Regina Phillips 
Councilor Kate Sykes 
Councilor Sarah Michniewicz 
 
 
1 
 
To submit written public comment on an agenda item, email edd@portlandmaine.gov. Submissions must be 
received by 12:00 pm the day before the Housing & Economic Development meeting to guarantee their 
inclusion in the agenda packet. All submissions must include the commenter's name and legal address. To help 
ensure your comment is submitted for the correct item, please include the name of the agenda item (see below). 
 
REMOTE ACCESS INFORMATION 
 
The Housing & Economic Development Committee will conduct this meeting remotely via Zoom pursuant to 
the Remote Meeting Policy adopted by the Portland City Council. Allow your computer to install the free Zoom 
app to get the best meeting experience. If you are not able to attend via Zoom, a recording will be available in 
the Agenda Center following the meeting. 
 
For public comment via Zoom, you will need to use the "raise your hand" feature. To raise your hand via the 
telephone, please hit *9. You will be unmuted by the host when it is time for public comment. 
 
https://portlandmaine-gov.zoom.us/j/83329598115?pwd=QnfQQHnN8dDEDPPXS55htOhMV8zKPz.1 
 
1. Review and vote to approve Minutes from the October 6, 2026 meeting  
     
  a. See attached draft Meeting Minutes from October 6, 2026 
      
2. Communication: Quarter 3 (7/1/2026 - 9/30/2026) Rent Control Report - Jessica 
Quattropani, Permitting and Inspections Department Director 
 
  
The Permitting and Inspections Department produced this quarterly communication to 
detail Rent Control activities for Quarter 3 of Calendar Year 2026 - from July 1, 2026, 
through September 30, 2026. The report includes information on the Rent Board, Rent 
Control Inspections, and the number of complaints (including founded and unfounded and 
in progress), audits, quality controls, and license reviews for the quarter. Committee action 
is not required.  
  
  a. See attached Quarter 3 Rent Control Report 
      
  b. See attached Allowable Increase Percentage & Short-term Rental Memorandum 
      
3. 
Public Comment: Review and vote on a recommendation to City Council regarding 
proposed amendments to the Rent Control Ordinance to strengthen enforcement - 
Councilor Pious Ali, Chair 
 
  
The Council identified “consider amendments to the Rent Control Ordinance to strengthen 
enforcement” as a priority in its 2026 Council Common Goals. At its July 21, 2026 
meeting, HEDC discussed potential policy changes and requested that the Office of the 
Corporation Counsel prepare an amended ordinance (enclosed) for Committee 
consideration. Public comment will be taken prior to Committee action.
2 
  a. See attached Memorandum 
      
  b. See attached redlined relevant portions of Chapter 6 
      
  c. Public Comment - See Attached 
      
4. Discussion: Panel Discussion with the Committee regarding Inclusionary Zoning (IZ) 
- Councilor Pious Ali, Chair 
 
  
Panelists include Bradley Davis - Founding Member of the Portland Tenants Union, and 
Ethan Strimling - Founding Member of Livable Portland. This is the second of three 
meetings the HEDC will hold as it moves forward to recommend possible IZ policy changes 
to the Planning Board. The first discussion with the HEDC was held on October 6, 2026. 
This item directly advances the City Council's 2026 Common Goals to accelerate housing 
production and strengthen affordability protections by considering adjustments to the IZ 
ordinance to promote housing production. No public comment will be taken on this item. 
  
  a. See attached Memorandum 
      
5. Verbal Update Regarding Bloomberg Cities Idea Exchange - No public comment will 
be taken. Mayor Mark Dion 
 
     
 
 
Next Meeting Date: November 17, 2026
